title: Gold-Tinted Polycarbonate Canopy
label: SOURCED
summary: Frameless one-piece bubble canopy with a thin conductive gold/indium-tin-oxide (ITO) coating to deflect radar energy away from the cockpit interior.
role: Provides unobstructed 360° visibility, bird-strike resistance, and electromagnetic shielding of the cockpit cavity.
materials: Optical polycarbonate laminate with vapor-deposited conductive gold/ITO film.
